paragraphs: Abba Yosef ben Dostai (a Tanna): Berakhot 28a.

notes.text: The William Davidson passages fully name Abba Yosef ben Dostai at Berakhot 28a and Rabbi Yaakov ben Dostai at Ketubot 111b. Rabbi Yehudah ben Dostai appears at Makkot 7a in that edition, beside Hyman’s retained 7b citation.
